outcome: Gestational age at planned cesarean section
cohort: The study participants were 77 perinatal centers and 300 primary facilities (hospitals or clinics) throughout Japan.
finding: Over 80% of obstetric facilities in Japan perform ultrasound screening for vasa previa with similar detection rates, but management strategies differ significantly between perinatal centers and primary facilities, particularly regarding the timing of planned cesarean sections.
mod_finding: The median gestational age at planned cesarean section was significantly earlier in perinatal centers (34 weeks) compared to primary facilities (37 weeks); one case without antenatal diagnosis required an emergency cesarean section at 38 weeks, resulting in neonatal death.
gest_age: Gestational age at planned cesarean section ranged from 34 to 37 weeks; one emergency cesarean section occurred at 38 weeks.
